# Apple: a faceted red ball 0.38 m across, a dark stalk and a leaf.
# Origin at the fruit's centre (a game bone pool: the game drops, catches and pops it).
new
material new Body --base-color 0.7059 0.3216 0.3216 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2941 0.2549 0.3451 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fruit --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.19 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.92
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Stalk --size 1 --location 0.02 0 0.225
scale 0.06 0.06 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Stem
material new Leaf --base-color 0.5412 0.6902 0.3765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name LeafA --size 1 --location 0.1 0 0.24
scale 0.16 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Leaf
select all
active Fruit
join
select all
shade flat
export apple.glb
